items.title: Build 01 — archive + Añasco slice
items.body: Sequential Build 01. Private DTRT_ARCHIVE snapshots. Public journey page. Añasco street. UNIT 12 without a pasted face.

items.title: RC6 — Añasco vertical slice
items.body: Hometown street, west-coast afternoon light, volume houses, hanging flag. UNIT 12 no longer uses a pasted face. Godot stays. Other worlds wait until Añasco clears the bar.

items.title: RC5 — website in the product
items.body: In-game Website, What’s new, Support, Contact, bug form with version. Optional desktop/Start Menu shortcuts. No production domain invented. Pre-order stays off until PayPal sandbox works.

items.title: RC4 — official site
items.body: Public site, press language, F12 shots. No new training modes.

items.title: RC3 — Puerto Rico worlds
items.body: Añasco gold. Seven more worlds as skins or shells. Same 12 m lane.
